Definition
[hinge]

Source: petersen:page-0462 A hinge in $(M,g)$ consists of two segments (or geodesics) $\overline{px}$ and $\overline{xy}$ that form an interior angle $\alpha =\angle (\overrightarrow {xp},\overrightarrow {xy})$ at the common vertex $x$, where the specified directions are tangent to the given segments.
